WITH account_sums AS (
  SELECT 
    trans.account_id,
    district.A3 as region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount 
             WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -trans.amount 
             ELSE 0 END) as account_sum,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM trans
  INNER JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
  INNER JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
  GROUP BY trans.account_id, district.A3
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(account_sum) as region_total
  FROM account_sums
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  account_sums.account_id,
  account_sums.region,
  account_sums.account_sum,
  account_sums.transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN region_totals.region_total = 0 THEN NULL 
       ELSE CAST(account_sums.account_sum AS REAL) / region_totals.region_total 
  END as share
FROM account_sums
INNER JOIN region_totals ON account_sums.region = region_totals.region
ORDER BY CASE WHEN share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, share DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each account belongs to exactly one district; the 'region' is district.A3. The amounts in trans are unsigned; direction is indicated by trans.type ('PRIJEM' for credit, 'VYDAJ' for withdrawal).

Transaction types other than 'PRIJEM' and 'VYDAJ' (e.g. 'VYBER') contribute 0 to the account_sum but are counted in transaction_count. When a region's total account_sum is zero (all accounts have net-zero activity), the share is NULL rather than undefined.
